models_evaluated: deep learning EHR-based Noonan syndrome risk model

links.outcome: Precision and specificity of the NS risk model on local EHR data, confirmed by sequencing
links.effect: Among 92,428 patients, 171 scored >0.8; precision 2.92% and specificity 99.82%; precision lower than prior validation (33.3%), attributed to prevalence differences rather than model degradation.
links.quote: While precision was lower than prior validation (33.3%), this reflected expected differences in disease prevalence rather than model degradation.

unlisted_practices: Genetic sequencing as reference standard to confirm EHR-based screening model flags for rare disease

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical and genetic validation of an EHR-based deep learning screening model for detecting Noonan syndrome across 92,428 patients, but does not compare or test specific deployment practices/guardrails.
